title: Loewe Linen Blend Long-Sleeve Shirt (LOT1683083-B05)
sizing: Size 50 for 183cm/75kg/96cm chest/46cm shoulders. Sizes 46-52 (S-XL), regular fit, 275g. Same fabric as the SS version but long-sleeve. Size 50 at 96cm chest should be comfortable.
notes: Viscose-linen blend via air-spinning technology. Smooth drape with structural rigidity, dual-channel moisture-wicking. Chest patch pocket with hidden hook Anagram embroidery (320 stitches/cm2). Anti-stretch mesh lining. Unisex fit. Long-sleeve companion to the SS version.
